notes: All customer data screens require a customerId route context.
Authorization handling is assumed external to this contract; pages must gracefully handle 403 responses.
No route for customer directory is defined because the API contract does not expose customer listing.
No generic policy listing screen is defined because the API contract only exposes policy versions for a known policyId.

pages.title: Execution Request Search
pages.purpose: Support request-level search for audit/troubleshooting and entry into specific execution investigations.
data_needs: Search form state: from_date, to_date, policy_ids, policy_version_ids, final_outcomes, promoted search_attributes (applicant_age, product_type, geography, loan_amount), page_size, cursor.
Search results list with request_id, correlation_id, policy/version, requested_at, final_outcome, outcome_reason_codes, search_attributes, metrics.
Optional version metadata for a known policyId via policy version selector utility.

api_consumes.usage: Primary search action and cursor-based pagination.
Optional helper to populate policy version choices when user provides a policyId.

user_actions: Enter and submit request search criteria.
Paginate to next results page using next_cursor.
Open execution detail for a selected request via request_id or correlation_id.
Open policy version selector helper for a known policyId.
loading_states: Initial empty/search-prompt state before first search.
Inline loading state on search submit.
Table pagination loading state when fetching next cursor page.
Version selector loading state when fetching policy versions.
error_states: 400 invalid search criteria with field-level validation summary.
Policy version helper shows error if policyId is invalid or versions cannot be loaded.

pages.title: Execution Request Detail
pages.purpose: Show complete request summary plus ordered execution trail for a request/correlation ID to explain why an approval/rejection/error occurred.
data_needs: Request summary fields including policy_id, policy_version_id, requested/completed times, final_outcome, reason codes, request/response payloads, search_attributes, metrics.
Ordered execution trail with record_type, sequence, rule/stage identifiers, execution_status, condition_results, input/output payloads, changed_values, message, outcome, duration_ms.

api_consumes.usage: Primary load for full summary and trail.
Optional lightweight refresh if implementing summary-first progressive loading; not required if full endpoint is used exclusively.

user_actions: Load by route parameter with lookupBy hint.
Toggle between summary, payloads, and trail tabs.
Filter visible trail rows client-side by record type/status/rule/stage within already loaded data.
Navigate to trail-only screen for technical focus.
loading_states: Page skeleton while full execution loads.
Secondary section skeletons for payload/trail tabs if progressively rendered.

pages.title: Execution Trail Only View
pages.purpose: Provide a narrower technical view of ordered execution events for a known request ID without the larger request summary context.
data_needs: request_id, customer_id, execution_trail event list.

api_consumes.usage: Optional link-preview/header enrichment if needed after trail load, using requestId as requestOrCorrelationId.

user_actions: Expand event payloads and changed values.
Client-side filter/sort within returned ordered list (without changing backend order semantics).

pages.title: Detailed Log Record Search
pages.purpose: Search across detailed rule/stage log records using metadata and limited payload content predicates.
data_needs: Search form fields: time range, policy/version, record_types, rule_id, rule_name, stage_name, execution_status, outcome, condition_result, content_filters, limit.
Results list including request_id, correlation_id, policy/version, event metadata, condition results, payload snippets, changed_values, message, duration_ms.
API note awareness that unsupported combinations of multiple dynamic content filters may be rejected.

api_consumes.usage: Optional helper for version selection when policyId is known.

user_actions: Add a constrained content filter for input/output/changed_values field_path and value.
Open parent execution detail from a selected result.
loading_states: Result-list incremental rendering for large payload snippets.
error_states: 400 invalid request including unsupported content filter combinations; UI should surface API limitation clearly.

pages.title: Policy Version Outcome Comparison
pages.purpose: Compare approval/rejection outcomes across selected versions of one policy over a date range.
data_needs: Known policy_id input.
Available versions metadata for selection.
Comparison results by policy_version_id with total_requests, outcome_counts, approval_count, rejection_count, approval_rate.

api_consumes.usage: Load selectable versions for the entered policy.

user_actions: Select one or more version IDs and date range.
Open segment comparison with same context.
Open rule behavior diff with chosen baseline and comparison versions.

pages.title: Policy Version Segment Comparison
pages.purpose: Compare outcome rates across versions segmented by one supported business field.
data_needs: policy_id, selected version_ids, date range, selected segment_field limited to allowed values.
Results with policy_version_id, segment_value, total_requests, outcomes, approval_rate.

api_consumes.usage: Optional helper to select versions for a known policy.

user_actions: Choose policy, versions, date range, and supported segment field.
Switch segment field among allowed options.
Drill back to version outcome comparison.
error_states: 400 unsupported or missing segment field/date/version inputs.

pages.title: Rule Behavior Diff Analysis
pages.purpose: Identify rules whose behavior differs between two versions so analysts can understand outcome changes.
data_needs: policy_id, baseline_version_id, comparison_version_id, date range.
Rule diff results: policy_version_id, rule_id, rule_name, status_outcome_breakdown, total_events.
user_actions: Select policy, baseline version, comparison version, and date range.
Sort rules by total_events or visible behavior change indicators client-side.
Open impacted-request analysis for a selected rule.

pages.title: Rule Impact Results
pages.purpose: Show requests affected by a given rule across selected versions and statuses/outcomes, enabling drill-down to concrete request audits.
data_needs: policy_id, version_ids, rule_id, date range, optional execution_status and outcome filters.
Results with request_id, policy_version_id, latest_event_time, statuses, outcomes.

api_consumes.usage: Optional lightweight preview when user selects a request without full navigation.

user_actions: Open request detail for a request.
loading_states: Inline preview loading state if request summary preview is used.

pages.title: Outcome Trend Dashboard
pages.purpose: Provide dashboard-ready trend visualization of request volumes and outcomes over time.
data_needs: Date range, optional policy_ids and policy_version_ids, bucket_unit.
Trend results by period_start with total_requests and per-outcome counts.

api_consumes.usage: Optional helper for version filters when a known policyId is used.

user_actions: Set date range and bucket unit.
loading_states: Empty state when no results returned.
error_states: 400 invalid date range or bucket unit.

pages.title: Segment Success Dashboard
pages.purpose: Show success/approval rates by a selected supported business segment for reporting use cases.
data_needs: Date range, optional policy_ids and policy_version_ids, supported segment_field.
Results with segment_value, total_requests, outcomes, success_rate.
user_actions: Set filters and supported segment field.
error_states: 400 unsupported segment field or missing inputs.

pages.title: Retention Overview
pages.purpose: Operational landing page for viewing logging enablement, retention settings, request stats, and recent purge activity.
data_needs: customer_id, customer_name, logging_enabled, retention_policy, request_stats, recent_purge_runs.

pages.title: Purge Run History
pages.purpose: Search and review historical purge runs for audit/operations.
data_needs: Search fields: from_date, to_date, statuses, optional scope policy/version.
Results with started/completed times, status, cutoff_time, scope, documents_deleted, notes.
user_actions: Search purge runs by range and status.

pages.title: Logging Configuration
pages.purpose: View and update customer logging enablement and retention settings.
data_needs: Current customer config: customer_name, deployment_type, logging_enabled, retention_policy.
Editable fields: logging_enabled, retention_days, purge_enabled, purge_threshold_gb.
user_actions: Edit logging toggle and retention settings.
error_states: 400 invalid supplied values with field-level validation messaging where possible.
Informational notice: no API exists to trigger purge immediately.

pages.title: Policy Version Selector
pages.purpose: Utility screen/modal to load policy version metadata and rule lists for a known policy ID, supporting analytics/report filters.
data_needs: Policy version metadata including version_id, version_label, published_at, status, rules[].
user_actions: Enter or receive policyId from context.
Select a rule for rule-impact/diff workflows.

constraints_and_gaps: No API exists to list customers; customer selection must come from host application context, route parameter, or out-of-band configuration.
No API exists to list all policies globally; policy-based analytics screens require entering or receiving a known policyId before loading versions.
No API exists to trigger a purge run; admin UI can only view retention overview/history and update config.
No API exists for report export, saved dashboards, scheduled reports, or sharing; frontend must not promise those features.
No API exists for arbitrary aggregation across any payload field for dashboards; segment fields are restricted to allowed promoted attributes.
Dynamic content filter support in detailed log search is constrained by the API/backend note; frontend should limit UI to combinations likely to be accepted and surface backend rejection clearly.
Authentication details are out of scope; pages should only model handling of 403/404/400/500 responses.
